description: Creates a personal Hoplix upload page for a campaign design and returns its upload_url and a design_upload_id (UPL-...). On that page the user uploads a PNG or JPG image (max 15 MB) from their device; images shared in a chat are not reachable by the server. The link expires in 30 minutes; uploaded images are deleted after 7 days. The design_upload_id is accepted by campaign creation as front or back design.
name: request_design_upload
title: Get an image upload link
